open_images_boxable_inventory.scope: Boxable class vocabulary only; not proof of samples or segmentation-mask availability. A picture-frame label is not a painting label. Raw CSV count differs from the official facts-page headline and has not been normalized.

open_images_pilot.license: Selected image metadata must explicitly list CC BY 2.0. Preserve original URL, landing URL, author when available, and license URL for each downloaded image. Open Images disclaims warranties; users remain responsible for source-image rights.

conversion.image_aligned_masks: Nearest-neighbor raster resize only, only for same-aspect ratio pairs with zero/unspecified rotation; source PNGs remain unchanged.
conversion.reason: No contour approximation or bounding-box-to-polygon conversion was made.

open_images_pilot.training_readiness_reason: Not ready: validation-only subset; no painting or hand instance masks; source annotations are not exhaustively complete for every instance; no independent train/test sample; no artwork harmful-contact labels. Tool masks are limited to source classes Pen and Mobile phone under the documented target mapping.

missing_work: Record consented, representative museum/gallery webcam sessions, including SAFE and NEAR cases.
Human-review LabelMe polygons for painting, person, hand, and tool; Open Images does not supply painting or hand masks.
Manually review SAFE/NEAR/CONTACT intervals; do not infer contact from box overlap.
Collect independent recording sessions for train, validation, and test; one session must never cross splits.
Resolve tool taxonomy, annotation completeness policy, and class balance from real recordings.
custom_readiness.training_readiness_reason: Not ready: need at least 10 reviewed polygons per target class, scene-completeness attestations, reviewed SAFE/NEAR/CONTACT labels, independent source-group splits with minimum counts, no hash leakage, valid provenance and no malformed reviewed annotations. Open Images has no painting/hand masks or artwork-contact labels.

met_artwork_inventory.license: CC0 1.0 only; source metadata must confirm isPublicDomain=true

mediapipe_hand_landmarker.output_type: 21 landmarks and handedness; no pixel mask or contact ground truth

object_segmentation.reason: The existing 100-image Open Images subset comes only from its official validation split and has incomplete target-instance annotation. It has no painting masks; Human hand is box-only. A source-grouped, complete training set for the desired task is not ready.

hand_localization.reason: MediaPipe supplies 21 hand landmarks and the integrated adapter tests fingertip points against the configured painting mask; it does not supply hand segmentation masks or calibrated contact labels. The package and Apache 2.0 task model are validated in an isolated environment; install requirements-hands.txt in the selected server environment before enabling it. Open Images Human hand labels are boxes only, and ContactHands hosted-image terms remain unstated.

painting_detection.reason: The fixed-camera polygon ROI is configurable. Met artwork images do not teach framed-painting scene detection.

artwork_contact_event.reason: No genuine painting-contact video labels are available. Synthetic logic scenarios are not real-world model training data.

training_readiness_reason: Not ready for the full painting/person/hand/tool task: no compatible, complete, independently split masks cover painting and hand. Person and Pen masks exist only in a small validation-only pilot with incomplete annotation coverage. No custom or contact-labeled videos are available.
